Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You stamp once, your shadow swelling across the feet gathered around you.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Brawn
Target / range / shape
Each other adjacent creature.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Attack

Your outline swells like a mountain’s shadow and your heel strikes the ground. Work out each target’s net Boons or Banes; make one roll using the combination least favorable to you and apply it to all targets. The size is momentary; you occupy your normal square.

Weak
2 physical damage and push 1.
Standard
3 physical damage and push 2.
Strong
5 physical damage, push 2 and knock prone.
